name: bubble
useFor: Use inside Message for each piece of a conversation with the agent. Use the default Bone frame with align end for what the person asked, ghost for the agent's answer (it reads like a report), secondary for a short reply or a note from another agent, muted for a system note and destructive for a question that failed. Stack consecutive bubbles in a BubbleGroup. BubbleReactions pins a short tag (2 sources) to an edge.
constraints: A cut corner anywhere but the top-left
An entrance animation on each bubble
source: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): Message, at the product scale
